dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are visible along the central dorsal-lateral axis. The most prominent 3-5 structures exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with a clear gradient transition from dark exterior to significantly lighter interior. One large 'C' shaped structure near the upper-center shows a jagged, non-uniform edge geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters localized primarily in the spaces between the larger macro-annuli and extending toward the posterior dorsal region. These clusters appear as concentrated points of high-intensity pixels without internal color gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with several smaller high-intensity blobs clustered linearly along the base of this triangle toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A series of overlapping, faint semi-circular markings creates a scalloped texture near the anterior-dorsal transition, distinct from the more isolated rings found on the mid-body.
